title: A bill to designate the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in San Angelo, Texas, as the "Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic".
official_summary: This act designates the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in San Angelo, Texas, as the Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic or the Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell VA Clinic.

summary.headline: A 2022 law renames the VA clinic in San Angelo, Texas, after Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell.
summary.what_it_does: This act names the Department of Veterans Affairs community-based outpatient clinic in San Angelo, Texas, after Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell. The clinic may be called either the Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic or the Colonel Charles and JoAnne Powell VA Clinic. The law only changes the name and does not change services or rules.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on October 17, 2022.
